I changed the fix to naming the new refs in the rollback write's retiredRefs.

others.why: Re-ran C1 and it failed as claimed (current [] instead of the refreshed pair). The mechanism holds at github-account-store.ts:76-95 and vault.ts:112-116: an errno at open() leaves disk null, so references() is [] and the reconcile deletes the staged pair. The next readable start then tombstones the retired old pair and finishStartup writes null. That is a real two-fault account loss, outside R13's same-session overwrite.

Re-ran D1 and an extra .bin was left. vault.ts:87-91 writes the .bin before persist() and has no cleanup when persist() fails, and the store never learns the ref. initialize() and reconcile() only walk index entries, so if nothing else persists in that session the encrypted file is never deleted. A real leak, though it is in vault.ts, outside the reviewed file.
